items.title: Prepare web content for Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with Crawl4AI
items.excerpt: This post shows how to use Crawl4AI, an open source web crawler, as a content preparation layer for Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, handling JavaScript rendering, selective extraction, and custom metadata enrichment before web content reaches an Amazon S3 data source.

items.title: Build efficient agents with knowledge distillation on Amazon SageMaker AI
items.excerpt: Agentic assistants built on frontier models run a multi-step tool loop, and paying frontier prices on every step is hard to sustain at production scale. This post shows how to use sequence-level knowledge distillation (SeqKD) to transfer a frontier teacher's agentic behavior into a small, lower-cost student on Amazon SageMaker AI.

items.title: Agentic engineering intelligence with Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.excerpt: Learn how to build a multi-agent engineering assistant that compresses aerospace component substitution evaluation from days to minutes, using Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and the Strands Agents SDK to assemble substitution evidence while keeping the engineer as the decision-maker.

items.title: How Circle K accelerated DevOps incident triage to under 15 minutes with Amazon Bedrock
items.excerpt: Circle K's DevOps team cut incident triage from 45-60 minutes to under 15 by building an agentic triage system on Amazon Bedrock. This post walks through the architecture, the initial Amazon Bedrock Flows implementation, the migration to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and the lessons learned from scaling it.
